pages.name: Reti: KIA, 2...c5 + 3...g6
pages.notes: Plan had Nbd2-f1-g3 through the f1-rook; ...b5-b4 said to undermine White's c-pawn. Rewritten around e4/c4 and ...e5 or queenside play.

pages.name: Reti: KIA, 2...c5 3.Bg2 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan had the f3-knight going to e1 with the king there; plan 4 read e4 as Black's move. Rewritten around the e4 break and ...d4.

pages.name: Reti: KIA, 2...c5 3.Bg2 Nf6 4.O-O Nc6
pages.notes: Plans read e4 as Black's move and were generic. Rewritten with ...e6/...e5 options and White's d4/c4 alternatives.

pages.name: Reti: KIA, French Variation
pages.notes: Plans had f2-f4 behind the f3-knight, Nf1-e3 with the rook on f1, and a b7-bishop not yet developed. Rewritten; reviewer rejections (a b7-bishop blocked by the c6-knight) fixed with ...Bb7/...Ba6 and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Reti: KIA, French Variation
pages.notes: Plan had Ng4 with no knight able to reach it. Rewritten around e5, Re1/Nf1/h4 and ...b5-b4 or ...dxe4.

pages.name: Reti: KIA, French Variation
pages.notes: Plan had f2-f4-f5 behind the f3-knight and vague bishop trades. Rewritten around the d6-bishop's control of e5.

pages.name: Zukertort Opening: Reversed Grünfeld
pages.notes: Overview called the set-up a KIA (it is a Tarrasch structure once c4 comes); plan read ...dxc4 without c4. Rewritten; reviewer rejection (g2-bishop pressing through the f3-knight) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Reti: Accepted, 3.e3 Nf6 4.Bxc4 e6
pages.notes: Plan had White fianchettoing a bishop that already stands on c4 and a minority attack with b4. Rewritten as a Queen's Gambit Accepted structure.

pages.name: Reti: Accepted, 3.g3 e6
pages.notes: Plan had Black solidifying a d5-pawn that has gone to c4 and e5 read as a move. Rewritten around Qa4+ or Na3 and ...c5.

pages.name: Reti: Accepted, 3.Na3
pages.notes: Plan used 0-0 and suggested holding the pawn with ...b5, which loses it to Nxb5. Rewritten.
